recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR source follow-up is needed unless future RDF generator work removes rdfs:subClassOf fhir:PrimitiveType from generated primitive classes.
issue_request: FHIR-13595 asked that primitive types in fhir.ttl, such as string, uri, and date, be subclasses of the primitive supertype. The issue is Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core datatypes and was applied for STU3.
initial_application: Historical commit 99d996178dbd5412f38eaf881928cbec99441533 explicitly fixed issue 13595 by changing the old FhirTurtleGenerator to generate primitive classes under Primitive. Jira also records an "already done" implementation comment before publication.
additional_context: The current checkout has refactored RDF generation, but source/fhir.ini actively includes primitivetype=types and source/datatypes/primitivetype.xml defines PrimitiveType as the parent for datatypes with a simple value. Current generated fhir.ttl output uses fhir:PrimitiveType and sampled primitive classes subclass it. The RDF page allows OWL/Turtle names to be refactored, so the current PrimitiveType naming still satisfies the original primitive-supertype request.
reconciliation: Created an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source files were edited because the active datatype source and current generated ontology already express the requested hierarchy.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-13594 was implemented in the same historical commit but concerns backbone element identifiers, not the primitive ontology hierarchy, so it was not decided here.
